source: https://www.threads.com/ measured with agent-browser snapshots of a throwaway account
auth_state: authenticated for feed; logged-out for logged-out fixture
replacements: usernames, post text, post IDs, media alt text, tracking URLs and profile data replaced with synthetic content; roles, nesting, control labels and URL patterns preserved
limits: one throwaway account, one host, one day; captcha/challenge, account survival, session portability and rate-limit banners were not measured

fixtures.note: measured 2026-11-13 (agent-browser snapshot -c -u of the home page and of a trends topic page); Trending-now links to /search?serp_type=trends sit outside the Column body

measured 2026-11-13 (agent-browser snapshot -c -u of a post page): the post carries a topic tag, so its timestamp permalink sits inside a nested generic and the only direct post link is the /media link
